show.name: Kevin from Work
show.summary: Kevin from Work is a single-cam series centered on Kevin, a young man who declares his unrequited love for his coworker Audrey in a letter, believing he'll never see her again after he accepts a job overseas. But when the opportunity falls through and Kevin is forced to return to his old job, how will he and Audrey continue to work together now that his feelings are no longer secret?

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: Kevin declares his unrequited love for his coworker Audrey, believing he'll never see her again after he accepts a job overseas.

episodes.name: Gossip from Work
episodes.summary: Kevin and Audrey attempt to make the best of an awkward work environment; the office newsletter shares the story of Kevin's personal note; Roxie bonds with Patti.

episodes.name: Who's Your Friend from Work
episodes.summary: Audrey becomes jealous after she sets her friend up with Kevin; Brian becomes Patti's personal trainer; unemployed Roxie decides to become an actress.

episodes.name: All About Work from Work
episodes.summary: Kevin's favorable performance review inspires him to help Ricky; Audrey recruits Patti to help solve a problem for Julia; Brian feels neglected and begins hanging out with Roxie.

episodes.name: Roommates from Work
episodes.summary: Kevin creates too many rules for Roxie's liking, so she moves out of his place and bunks with Patti and Audrey. Meanwhile, Kevin fears a romance is blossoming between Roxie and Roger.

episodes.name: Birthday from Work
episodes.summary: Kevin and Audrey are in charge while Julia's away tending to a cat emergency, and Kevin just wants to get through the day quietly without anyone finding out it's his birthday, while Audrey tries to put her management skills to the test.

episodes.name: Secrets from Work
episodes.summary: Kevin learns that Julia has a secret bathroom at work and shares this discovery with Audrey. Elsewhere, Roxie finds herself in an awkward situation after she gives Patti advice.

episodes.name: Aftershock from Work
episodes.summary: Kevin is put in charge of the office earthquake drill on the same day that he has an important interview. Meanwhile, Kevin avoids Audrey after an awkward confrontation; Brian helps Patti's boyfriend prove his manliness to her; and Roxie confronts Audrey about her treatment of Kevin.

episodes.name: Escape from Work
episodes.summary: Homebound Kevin has a black-and-white dream about Audrey and his work-related troubles; Roxie tries to secure the services of a handsome male nurse; Patti tags along on Audrey's dates with Brock.

episodes.name: Team Kevin from Work
episodes.summary: Kevin tires of being "Mr. Nice Guy" and decides to take advantage of Audrey and Brock's relationship difficulties.

show.name: La legge di Lidia Poët
show.summary: In this gripping period drama, Lidia Poët investigates murders while fighting to practice law. Inspired by the true story of Italy's first female lawyer.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: When a ballerina turns up dead, her alleged stalker is accused of murder. Desperate, the suspect's mother turns to Italy's first female lawyer for help.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Much to Enrico's chagrin, Lidia agrees to defend an anarchist accused of murder. But the scandal goes deeper than she expected and lands her in trouble.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Lidia and Enrico discover some family secrets when, in an opioid haze, a man from Lidia's past confesses to patricide in her childhood home.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: A woman very similar to Lidia — educated, underestimated, scorned — is on trial. Lidia wants to represent her, but is she too invested to see the truth?

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: After a seance at a wild party, a wealthy businessman mysteriously expires, and the most likely suspect has been locked in an asylum for years.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: Lidia uncovers a conspiracy and faces a choice: Should she stay and make her way in a place that doesn't want her, or seek her fortune elsewhere?

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: Lidia is determined to keep fighting for equality. When a friend is murdered and found with two cryptic notes in his pocket, she teams up with Jacopo.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: As Lidia investigates a mysterious poisoning at a prestigious boarding school, Jacopo digs deeper into their friend's death and Marianna uncovers a lie.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Enrico remains doubtful about running for Parliament while Prosecutor Fourneau and Lidia struggle to connect the victims of a series of brutal murders.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: An unexpected wedding is disrupted by an unexpected death. As Lidia looks to get to the bottom of it, Enrico prepares a very important speech.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Despite Lidia's conflicted feelings for Fourneau, the murder of a prison guard forces them to collaborate again, as Jacopo edges closer to finding Nitti.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: In the wake of a shooting, Fourneau takes over the Nitti investigation. Enrico receives an eminent guest, while Lidia and Jacopo race against the clock.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: The arrival of an old friend with a desperate plea shakes Lidia's relationships and beliefs as she investigates a mysterious death at the circus.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: As Lidia and Fourneau land on opposing sides of a case that hits close to home, Enrico aids a painter whose alibi for a murder hints at a larger scandal.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Jacopo volunteers to help Lidia solve a boxer's murder after Fourneau uncovers a hole in Grazia's story, forcing Enrico to frantically pivot his defense.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: A key witness misses his court date, leading Lidia to discover he's facing a shocking charge of his own. Consuelo begins to question Jacopo's love.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: The press speculates about Lidia's tryst with Fourneau, pushing Enrico to distance himself from his sister as Jacopo digs into Fontana's military career.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: While teaming up to search Fontana's estate, Lidia and Jacopo unearth a vital clue they hope will alter the outcome of Grazia's landmark case.

show.name: La primera vez
show.summary: A mysterious teen girl arrives at an all-boys school in 1970s Colombia, breaking stereotypes, rules... and a few hearts.

episodes.name: Lisístrata
episodes.summary: Upon Eva's arrival, her classmates — particularly Camilo — take to her "teachings" and musings. But not everyone is warm and welcoming.

episodes.name: La dama de las camelias
episodes.summary: Suspecting Eva is too good to be true, the guys investigate her, but it's they who end up exposed. The gang has a life-altering, first-time experience.

episodes.name: Retrato del artista adolescente
episodes.summary: Upon hearing Eva might leave the school, the guys huddle and devise a scheme to help her stay… ultimately setting the stage for an explosive scene.

episodes.name: Una habitación propia
episodes.summary: Eva makes a strong impression on Camilo's parents. The group's clandestine project gets Camilo and Eva suspended. Pabón receives devastating news.

episodes.name: La letra escarlata
episodes.summary: With Estela's word against Mr. Pabón's, Camilo and Eva must dig deeper to find out the truth — all amidst hefty accusations and arguments.

episodes.name: Siddhartha
episodes.summary: Camilo's suspicions about Eva's story deepen. He offers to help her with her grades but she has other plans — which pierce a dagger in his heart.

episodes.name: Tess d'Urbervilles
episodes.summary: After a night of drinking, Eva lets intimate details of her life slip out, prompting Camilo to ask Arbeláez to keep a close eye on her.

episodes.name: Las penas de amor del joven Werther
episodes.summary: Protests in the streets cause tension amongst the group and in Camilo's home. Camilo proceeds with a Machiavellian plan to make Eva jealous.

episodes.name: Así habló Zaratustra
episodes.summary: Camilo finds himself in a tricky position, but one where he can finally express his feelings. There's only one problem: the recipient of his affection.

episodes.name: Las enseñanzas de don Juan
episodes.summary: Eva comes to Camilo's rescue. Martín blames Eva for the group's constant feuding. A party seemingly gone awry opens a window of opportunity for Camilo.

episodes.name: De profundis
episodes.summary: Camilo's dad's plan to take him to see a priest backfires. Martín opens up like never before. The gang must say goodbye to a dear friend.

episodes.name: Jungla de asfalto
episodes.summary: Eva and Camilo have a blast getting into mischief. Camilo shows just how far he'll go to protect Eva, finally finding the key to her heart.

episodes.name: El guardián entre el centeno
episodes.summary: While his parents navigate their roughest patch, Camilo enjoys his sunniest days with Eva. But will their love survive the gloomy horizon?

episodes.name: Cartas a un joven poeta
episodes.summary: Eva's return is bittersweet for Camilo, while Luisa's escape from boarding school prompts a reality check for everyone. Salcedo and Castro grow suspicious.

episodes.name: El segundo sexo
episodes.summary: Wrong assumptions favor Camilo, but not for long. Luisa's change of heart sparks a subtle act of rebellion. Trouble brews in Ana and José's marriage.

episodes.name: Cartas a un niño que nunca nació
episodes.summary: The students rally for justice, except Salcedo. A parent-teacher meeting results in a heated debate and a discouraging outcome. Eva has a sneaky idea.

episodes.name: Los viajes de Gulliver
episodes.summary: Grief and joy intertwine in the gang's holiday, with the biggest surprise waiting in Bucaramanga. Ana's wishes to remain solo continue, to Jose's dismay.

episodes.name: Cuando Dios era mujer
episodes.summary: After a promising arrival in Cartagena, Camilo's dreams take a hit — both in love and work. And he's not the only one dealing with unrequited affection.

episodes.name: La revolución sexual
episodes.summary: Camilo strives to win Eva's favor, but an intriguing new figure complicates things for him. As Luisa struggles, she finds comfort in someone unexpected.

episodes.name: Doña flor y sus dos maridos
episodes.summary: Camilo starts to warm up to Alfredo — until he reveals his true intentions. Their new teacher brings knowledge for some and flashbacks for others.

episodes.name: ¡Que viva la música!
episodes.summary: A trippy experience prompts Eva to open up to Camilo, who questions his role in her life. When Rosario opens up, bombshells drop — especially on José.

episodes.name: El orígen de la familia, la propiedad privada y el estado
episodes.summary: Camilo shares what he discovered with the crew. Later on, he and Eva pay a visit to Rosario's home, while José returns home again.

episodes.name: Crímen y castigo
episodes.summary: Eva mobilizes to create the student council. As change looms, Camilo ponders if apparent endings are simply the start of new beginnings.

episodes.name: Jane Eyre
episodes.summary: As major exams loom – and bring startling revelations — Camilo enlists the Acuña brothers for an illicit mission. José attempts to woo Ana.

episodes.name: Un tranvía llamado Deseo
episodes.summary: An impending military exam causes strife among Salcedo, Pabón, Castro and Arbeláez. A new play and a new face turn Salcedo's life upside down.

episodes.name: Sobre la fotografía
episodes.summary: A military draft throws the gang into disarray right before graduation. As Eva's life grows more complicated, so does her relationship with Camilo.

episodes.name: La increíble y triste historia de la cándida Eréndira y su abuela desalmada
episodes.summary: As the future unfolds, so do the group's opportunities. Lucy's announcement angers José. Pabón and Quiñonez clash in the military.

episodes.name: El señor de las moscas
episodes.summary: Camilo, Eva and the gang enter into a new chapter of their lives. Janet's suggestion takes José by surprise. Pabón turns the tables on Quiñonez.

episodes.name: El Kamasutra
episodes.summary: Pabón helps Quiñonez. As Camilo struggles with Eva's interest in their professor, a wild night unleashes his insecurities. Ana receives good news.

episodes.name: Lolita
episodes.summary: Camilo's jealousy blinds him as Eva's secrets mount. Pabón pushes back on the military's decision. José makes a special request of Camilo.

episodes.name: Siempre
episodes.summary: Reeling from Eva's decision, Camilo spirals. Salcedo's drug use presents consequences for the group. An idea gives Camilo a new opportunity.

episodes.name: El diario de Ana Frank
episodes.summary: As the police search for Eva, she comes clean about Silva's affiliations. An old face reunites with Salcedo and Luisa. A house party goes awry.

episodes.name: La peste
episodes.summary: Luisa and Arbeláez plan their future as a phone call urges Eva back to the U.S. Pabón confronts Quiñonez. Camilo falls deeper into the friend zone.

episodes.name: La primera mujer
episodes.summary: After debuting his first novel, Camilo is shaken when his friends turn against him. Luisa and Arbeláez's decision opens the door to 364.

episodes.name: Ideario feminista
episodes.summary: Eva's visit to the Dominican Republic's embassy is unexpectedly interrupted. Camilo and the group mobilize to stop a tragedy from occurring.

episodes.name: Vainas y otros poemas
episodes.summary: Eva and Camilo take a big step in their relationship. Vandalia's activities threaten the group's safety. Rosario tries to start a school for Janet.

episodes.name: La señorita Julia
episodes.summary: A move highlights the differences between Eva and Camilo's lives. Arbeláez defends Janet, and a visitor throws a wrench in Ana and José's relationship.

episodes.name: México y el viaje al país de los Tarahumaras
episodes.summary: Money troubles push Camilo and Eva over the edge. Janet makes a proposal to Rosario and José regarding her future. Lucy joins the tenants of 364.

episodes.name: El teatro y su doble
episodes.summary: A trip to Cauca for a special ceremony yields breakthroughs for Eva and Pabón. José helps Camilo find a legendary wrestler.

episodes.name: Crítica de la economía política del signo
episodes.summary: Eva's new job has unforeseen challenges. A series of massive life changes put Camilo and Eva under intense pressure. A familiar face returns.

episodes.name: Delta de Venus
episodes.summary: Eva pursues a new career. A chat with Estela inspires Lucy to step out of her comfort zone. A critique of Camilo's novel leads him to new pursuits.

episodes.name: Seis personajes en busca de un autor
episodes.summary: Eva's and Camilo's careers take off, as Pabón falls in love. A talk with Castro leaves Salcedo suspicious as relationships implode.

episodes.name: La Biblia
episodes.summary: Salcedo's addiction catches up to him, and an invitation from José changes his life. The AIDS epidemic shakes Pabón. Eva's work trip unbalances Camilo.

episodes.name: Sobre la educación
episodes.summary: Three years later, Eva returns to Colombia — but she isn't alone. Camilo lashes out. Janet makes a new friend, much to José's consternation.

episodes.name: El atravesado
episodes.summary: The group makes a movie, but an M-19 incident changes the course of their lives. Oswald throws José a curveball, and Ana's proposal takes off.

show.name: Last Resort
show.summary: 500 feet beneath the ocean's surface, the U.S. ballistic missile submarine Colorado receive their orders. Over a radio channel, designed only to be used if their homeland has been wiped out, they're told to fire nuclear weapons at Pakistan. Captain Marcus Chaplin demands confirmation of the orders only to be unceremoniously relieved of duty by the White House. XO Sam Kendal finds himself suddenly in charge of the submarine and facing the same difficult decision. When he also refuses to fire without confirmation of the orders, the Colorado is targeted, fired upon, and hit. The submarine and its crew find themselves crippled on the ocean floor, declared rogue enemies of their own country. Now, with nowhere left to turn, Chaplin and Kendal take the sub on the run and bring the men and women of the Colorado to an exotic island. Here they will find refuge, romance and a chance at a new life, even as they try to clear their names and get home.

episodes.name: Captain
episodes.summary: Five hundred feet beneath the ocean's surface, the crew of the Ohio-class ballistic missile submarine "USS Colorado" - the most powerful nuclear submarine ever built -- receive their orders. Over a communications channel designed only to be used if the U.S. homeland has been wiped out, they're told to fire nuclear weapons at a foreign country. Captain Marcus Chaplin demands confirmation of the orders, only to be unceremoniously relieved of duty. XO Sam Kendal finds himself suddenly in charge of the submarine and facing the same difficult decision. When he also demands confirmation of the orders, the Colorado is fired upon and hit. The submarine and its crew, honorable patriots, now find themselves crippled on the ocean floor and declared rogue enemies of their own country.

episodes.name: Blue on Blue
episodes.summary: More than 20 warships are closing on the 200-mile perimeter that Marcus Chaplin declared as a no man's land around the island. And as XO Sam Kendal is drawn into a battle on the ground to keep them alive, Prosser confronts Marcus about something personal to him that could be impacting his judgment as Captain of the Colorado.

episodes.name: Eight Bells
episodes.summary: Marcus leads a search for three missing crew members of the Colorado, a search that leads them to Serrat's compound, where they receive an ominous demand. Meanwhile, a clandestine meeting between Kylie and Admiral Shepard confirms that the order to fire came through a back channel.

episodes.name: Voluntold
episodes.summary: Even as Marcus and Sam learn that they have been charged with treason against the United States, a greater threat within their own crew is brewing. Meanwhile, an old friend of Sam's, Paul Wells, pays Christine a visit and tries to ease her fears about her husband.

episodes.name: Skeleton Crew
episodes.summary: In an attempt to end the standoff on Sainte Marina, Marcus and Sam enter into tense negotiations with the U.S. Government. Meanwhile, when a critical system fails, Grace must take command of the Colorado on a perilous repair operation.

episodes.name: Another Fine Navy Day
episodes.summary: The crew is hit with an attack by an unknown force unlike anything they've seen before. As confusion and aggression take hold, Marcus and Sam can no longer trust their own senses even as they race to save the sub and defend the island.

episodes.name: Nuke It Out
episodes.summary: As Marcus and Sam hunt for the traitor in their ranks who stole their nuclear launch key, Prosser disobeys orders and starts a small war he can't control. Meanwhile Grace and James must work together to defuse a dangerous situation, as back in D.C. Christine is indicted as Sam's co-conspirator.

episodes.name: Big Chicken Dinner
episodes.summary: Marcus brings the members of the Colorado and the islanders all together to celebrate their two cultures -- a feast in the spirit of Thanksgiving. But the good times turn bad the next morning when an essential crew member is accused of a serious crime. Grace handles the man's defense and is tasked with finding out the truth.

episodes.name: Cinderella Liberty
episodes.summary: A visit that will soon turn into a nightmare as Marcus must consider the unthinkable once again. Meanwhile, the true reason for the nuclear devastation in Pakistan is revealed.

episodes.name: Blue Water
episodes.summary: Sam and James depart the island in a daring rescue attempt. Back on the island of Sainte Marina, a Chinese diplomat arrives to make a deal with Marcus. With scarcity and a prison problem plaguing him, Marcus finds himself treading down a more treacherous path than he could have imagined.

episodes.name: Damn the Torpedoes
episodes.summary: Typhoon, a mutiny and a Washington coup d'etat will force Marcus and his crew into unlikely alliances. As Sam's grief strains his loyalty to Marcus, will Sainte Marina get the supplies it so desperately needs? How far will Marcus go to ensure the crew's survival -- will it cost him his life?

episodes.name: The Pointy End of the Spear
episodes.summary: Kylie works with Admiral Shepard to bring down the President, using evidence of what really happened in Pakistan. This affords Marcus the opportunity to surrender the Colorado, if all goes according to plan.

episodes.name: Controlled Flight into Terrain
episodes.summary: In the exciting season finale, a violent battle for control erupts on the submarine, which leaves the Colorado vulnerable to capture by a third party -- one with an exploitative plan. Can Marcus and Sam take control of the sub before it's too late?

show.name: Legend of the Seeker
show.summary:
In a mythical land, one man, Richard Cypher, discovers his true destiny as he, a mysterious young woman, a wise old wizard and a magical sword are all that stand between the evil tyrant Darken Rahl and his quest for total domination.

Based on The Sword of Truth series of books by Terry Goodkind.

episodes.name: Prophecy
episodes.summary: In a distant land, Richard Cypher discovers his true destiny as he, a mysterious young woman, a wise old wizard and a magical sword are all that stand between the evil tyrant Darken Rahl and his quest for total domination.

episodes.name: Destiny
episodes.summary: Using the wisdom of wizards, Richard chases Fane in hope of taking back the sacred Book of Counted Shadows.

episodes.name: Bounty
episodes.summary: When Darken Rahl offers a reward to anyone who captures the Seeker, deadly mercenaries set their sights on Richard Cypher, turning him from hunter to hunted.

episodes.name: Brennidon
episodes.summary: Richard returns to the town of Brennidon, where he was born during Darken Rahl's massacre of every eldest son to avert the prophecy of the Seeker. He finds that the townspeople have given up their freedom under Rahl's rule, and discovers a secret from his past.

episodes.name: Listener
episodes.summary: Darken Rahl's D'Haran soldiers capture Renn, a ten-year-old boy known as a Listener, a person with the ability to read anyone's thoughts, and a very valuable tool for those who control him. When Richard and Kahlan take Renn from his captors, the mind-reading child threatens to reveal their deepest of secrets to each other.

episodes.name: Elixir
episodes.summary: Richard, Kahlan and Zedd discover that peddlers are selling the villagers of Drundril elixirs, potions that temporarily give them magical powers. Searching for the makers of the potions, Zedd confronts a wizard who was once his student, but is now a dangerous and powerful rival.

episodes.name: Identity
episodes.summary: Richard learns that Darken Rahl's most trusted commander, Demmin Nass, is assembling a massive force of D'Haran troops. But when Richard refuses to believe an evil witch woman who says Nass will kill him, she casts a spell which causes Richard and an unsuspecting villager to trade identities, convincing everyone that the villager is really the Seeker.

episodes.name: Denna
episodes.summary: When Kahlan's feelings for Richard begin to compromise her mission, she sets off in search of another Confessor to guide the Seeker. In the meantime, Richard and Zedd are attacked by a group of D'Haran soldiers and a Mord'Sith named Denna. After capturing Richard, Denna attempts to coerce him into joining forces with the evil Darken Rahl.

episodes.name: Puppeteer
episodes.summary: Evil Queen Milena is in possession of the third and final Box of Orden. To prevent the box from falling into the hands of Darken Rahl and giving him the ultimate power he so desperately craves, Zedd disguises himself as an entertainer in order to infiltrate Milena's castle. With the help of a little slave girl named Rachel, Zedd plots to replace the coveted box with a fake. Meanwhile, Richard and Kahlan learn that Darken Rahl intends to personally retrieve the Box of Orden from the Queen.

episodes.name: Sacrifice
episodes.summary: With Richard's help, Kahlan disguises herself as a Mord'Sith to rescue her pregnant sister Dennee - who is also a Confessor - from a D'Haran prison. When Dennee gives birth to a son, Richard is horrified to learn that it's mandated that male offspring of Confessors be put to death and resolves to save the child, putting him at odds with Kahlan.

episodes.name: Confession
episodes.summary: Zedd seeks out a relative in his quest to secure a safe hiding place for the Box of Orden while Richard and Kahlan investigate a series of murders among members of the resistance. Believing she has caused an innocent man to be executed, Kahlan begins to doubt her ability as a Confessor.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.summary: On his quest to uncover the final Box of Orden and achieve ultimate world domination, the evil Darken Rahl enlists his wizard, Giller, to cast the Spell of the Lying Moon on Richard. With the Seeker now caught in the grips of a mysterious dream-like trance, it's up to Kahlan and Zedd to free him of the spell before Richard reveals where he has hidden the third Box of Orden.

episodes.name: Revenant
episodes.summary: A quest to hide the Box of Orden from the clutches of Darken Rahl leads Richard, Kahlan and Zedd to the Crypt of Tavol'Rang - the burial place of the legendary Seeker, Kieran. But when the storied hero's sarcophagus is discovered empty, Richard and Kahlan soon learn that a deception from the past could cost them their future.

episodes.name: Hartland
episodes.summary: When Darken Rahl establishes a foothold in the Seeker's hometown, Richard, Kahlan and Chase must journey through the boundary to save Hartland from the forces of darkness. But once there, Richard and his companions find that the villagers have welcomed the evil D'Harans with open arms.

episodes.name: Conversion
episodes.summary: Darken Rahl is determined to have his personal wizard, Giller, harness a powerful magical force that will help Rahl enslave the world. But Richard's attempts to rescue his friends from the sadistic wizard's deadly experiments send him into his first explosive face-to-face confrontation with the evil Rahl.

episodes.name: Bloodline
episodes.summary: Darken Rahl enlists the help of Denna, a dangerous Mord-Sith, to locate the Third Box of Orden and give him the final key to world domination. Meanwhile, Richard's quest to thwart Rahl's evil plan leads to a startling revelation about his friend, Zedd.

episodes.name: Deception
episodes.summary: In an effort to crush the resistance, Darken Rahl enlists the help of his evil sorcerers to create lethal weaponry that wipes out entire villages. Richard infiltrates an enemy camp in order to steal the deadly weapons from the D'Harans.

episodes.name: Mirror
episodes.summary: Two opportunistic thieves plot to steal the Sword of Truth by using magic to disguise themselves as Richard and Kahlan. Meanwhile, the real Richard must battle a lethal Mord' Sith in order to free himself and Kahlan from the evil clutches of Darken Rahl's brutal D'Haran soldiers.

episodes.name: Cursed
episodes.summary: To protect his kingdom from Darken Rahl's D'Haran soldiers, a king asks the help of Shota, the witch woman. Her magic transforms him, nightly, into a vicious beast that slays the soldiers. But when the creature turns on his own people, The Seeker is called upon to stop the murders.

episodes.name: Sanctuary
episodes.summary: With news that a prophetic manuscript lies hidden in a nearby village, the Seeker embarks on a desperate race with the ruthless Darken Rahl to locate the ancient book. If Richard finds it in time, he could learn how to defeat the evil Rahl and rescue the world from total destruction.

episodes.name: Fever
episodes.summary: Darken Rahl takes an unlikely captive in a violent attempt to get his hands on the Three Boxes of Orden - the final keys he needs to unlock the power of total world domination. Meanwhile, time is running out for Kahlan and Zedd as they fall victim to a horrific plague unleashed by Rahl.

episodes.name: Reckoning
episodes.summary: Darken Rahl and his Mord'Sith find Richard and Kahlan just as they are preparing to unleash the power of Orden, which would destroy the sinister tyrant once and for all. The resulting explosion of power consumes the Seeker, leaving Kahlan in the clutches of Rahl.

episodes.name: Marked
episodes.summary: In the riveting second season premiere, Richard discovers that in defeating the sinister tyrant Darken Rahl, victory is short-lived when he inadvertently opens a rift to the underworld, unleashing an even greater evil on the world of the living. As Richard, Kahlan and Zedd prepare for a quest to find the Stone of Tears, the only force that can close the rift, Triana, a defiant Mord'Sith, challenges Cara's authority.

episodes.name: Baneling
episodes.summary: The quest for the Stone of Tears brings Richard, Kahlan, Zedd and Cara to a D'Haran prison where the dead return from the underworld to prey on the living. But as the Seeker races to stop the senseless killing, he discovers that someone who holds the key to locating the all-important Stone, which will seal the rift to the underworld, has struck a deadly deal of his own.

episodes.name: Broken
episodes.summary: Richard sends Cara away to excape the wrath of Kahlan when it's revealed that the Mord'Sith is responsible for the death of someone very close to the Confessor. But upon Cara's return to her hometown village, local townspeople put the Mord'Sith on trial for the horrific crimes she's committed in the past. With Cara's fate now completely in Kahlan's hands, the Confessor must make a life-or-death decision.

episodes.name: Touched
episodes.summary: While Zedd and Cara follow a lead in tracking down the Stone of Tears, Kahlan learns of a mysterious girl who proves to be the only other living Confessor. She and Richard set out to rescue the teenager from evil forces and prevent her from accidentally unleashing the power she possesses.

episodes.name: Wizard
episodes.summary: Zedd falls victim to a mysterious spell that strips him of his memory - and his old age. Emboldened by his newfound youth, the once-wise wizard is convinced he must replace Richard with a new Seeker to find the Stone of Tears and save a town threatened by a rift to the Underworld. Now, it's up to Richard, Kahlan and Cara to rescue a powerful and arrogant young Zedd from a lethal showdown with Darken Rahl and the Keeper of the Underworld.

episodes.name: Fury
episodes.summary: Richard and Cara help a small group of villagers escape ruthless slave traders, killing the aggressors in the process. The deaths disappoint the matriarch of the victimized people, a pacifist group called the Minders. Some of them, though, are tired of turning the other cheek while they are being subjugated and slaughtered, and enlist the Seeker's aid in showing them how to protect themselves against future attacks. But Richard's attempt to teach the Minders self-defense skills unleashes their building rage, which threatens to consume them and destroy the Seeker.

episodes.name: Resurrection
episodes.summary: In the wake of Darken Rahl's death, one of his commanders, General Grix, tries to claim the throne of D'Hara for himself and eliminate anyone who could challenge him, including Richard Cypher, the rightful heir. Kahlan and Zedd track Grix's D'Haran soldiers, who plan to threaten his rivals with deadly force. Meanwhile, Richard and Cara track Grix to a brothel run by Denna, the Mord'Sith who once tried to eliminate the Seeker for Rahl. Richard soon discovers he is to be an unwilling pawn in Denna's deadly plot to control the throne herself, a scheme in which he may pay the ultimate price.

episodes.name: Light
episodes.summary: Richard, Kahlan, Zedd, and Cara track down the evil Mord'Sith Denna, who took the compass needed to find the Stone of Tears. But Denna eludes them and escapes with a captive Zedd. In pursuit, Richard is suddenly crippled by a series of debilitating headaches, after which he encounters members of an order of women known as the Sisters of the Light. They reveal Richard must immediately abandon his mission to rescue Zedd and instead begin a dangerous life-changing journey, or the mysterious headaches will kill him.

episodes.name: Dark
episodes.summary: As the Sisters of the Light train Richard to use his wizard power, the beautiful and mysterious Sister Nicci reveals a shocking secret about his hosts at the Palace of the Prophets. Elsewhere, Shota the witch woman reveals to Zedd that he has no choice but to name a new Seeker in Richard's absense. Zedd, Kahlan and Cara set out to find the person destined to next wield the Sword of Truth, while Richard, unvertain whom to trust, is forced into a dark alliance with Sister Nicci.

episodes.name: Perdition
episodes.summary: Trapped in the deadly Valley of Perdition, Richard's worst fears come magically to life and threaten to kill him. Enduring powerful and disturbing visions about those he holds dear, Richard is forced to make gut-wrenching choices that test his will, tempt his sense of right and wrong, and take him to the brink of death. Meanwhile, the world's most powerful sorceress, Sister Nicci, plots to murder Kahlan, who leads Zedd, Cara and the new Seeker, Leo, on a quest to find Richard. During their long journey, Cara's deepening feelings for Leo bring her to an emotional crossroads.

episodes.name: Torn
episodes.summary: When Kahlan's homeland of Aydindril is taken over by the ruthless Prince Fyren. she and Zedd realize they must go to the legendary city to reclaim it from the tyrant, leaving Richard and Cara to continue the search for the Stone of Tears. However, when a magical accident occurs that seems to have stripped Kahlan of her powers, Richard soon realizes the situation is more complex--and dangerous--than it first appears.

episodes.name: Hunger
episodes.summary: While the Keeper wages war on the living, Richard, Kahlan, Zedd and Cara set out to rescue a group of villagers who may have been kidnapped by banelings -- dead souls returned from the Underworld by the Keeper in exchange for killing someone every day to stay alive. As the rescue attempt grows intense, Cara proposes a deadly covenant with the ruthless Darken Rahl to protect the Seeker. Meanwhile, a dubious magic peddler strikes a deal with Zedd's wayward brother to sell a potion that might threaten Rahl's plan and cure banelings of their bloodlust once and for all.

episodes.name: Princess
episodes.summary: The Sisters of the Dark conjure the world's most powerful sorceress, Sister Nicci, back from the Underworld, and she brings with her a scheme to help the Keeper put an end to all life. The evil Sister Nicci negotiates a deadly deal with the richest man alive, the Margrave of Rothenberg. To fulfill his end of the bargain, the Margrave captures Kahlan and prepares her for delivery to the Keeper. A spell cast over the Margrave's land prevents anyone from using magic to free the Confessor. Learning that the Margrave is planning to choose a new bride, Richard and Zedd devise a plan to infiltrate the protected realm and rescue Kahlan. Posing as refined royalty, with the Seeker and Wizard disguised as her entourage, a reluctant Cara must compete in an elaborate masquerade of manners to win the chauvinistic Margrave's affections - before the Sisters of the Dark arrive and claim his prisoner for her deadly date with the Keeper.

episodes.name: Bound
episodes.summary: The Sisters of the Dark turn against their leader, the dangerous Sister Nicci, after she twice fails to kill Kahlan. Threatened by Darken Rahl, and hunted by the disciples who now want her dead, Sister Nicci comes up with a shocking plan to redeem herself in the eyes of the Keeper. By casting a powerful spell that directly links her life to Kahlan's, Richard has no choice but to protect Nicci from her enemies and lead her to the Stone of Tears in order to save Kahlan's life. Now, Kahlan's only hope to break the spell lies with the last person she ever wants to see again - her father.

episodes.name: Creator
episodes.summary: A mysterious and powerful woman claiming to be the living incarnation of the Creator makes shocking accusations against Richard. Now, the Seeker stands in judgment before this self-proclaimed deity, and Kahlan, Cara and Zedd are his only defense. Their one chance to save Richard means unraveling the mystery of this woman's identity, a puzzle which ultimately becomes a matter of life and death for the Seeker. Meanwhile, when Darken Rahl learns that a woman claiming to be the Creator has appeared on earth, he devises his own deadly plan to destroy her.

episodes.name: Desecrated
episodes.summary: A birthday celebration for Richard goes horribly wrong when a grief-stricken magician unleashes a lethal plan to avenge the unjust deaths of his sons, killed in the war against Darken Rahl. To exact revenge on those responsible, the conflicted conjurer traps Kahlan and Cara in a tomb and causes the release of a bloodthirsty Nygaax - a mummy ruled by dark magic. Now, with time and air running out, it's up to the Seeker to rescue the Confessor and Cara. Meanwhile, an even deadlier fate awaits Zedd upon the arrival of the Nygaax.

episodes.name: Vengeance
episodes.summary: Zedd's brother Thaddicus discovers that their father's killer, who was assumed to have perished at the hand of Darken Rahl, is still alive. Upon learning the grim news, Zedd leaves Richard, Kahlan and Cara, reuniting with Thaddicus on a secret quest to avenge their father's murder. While the siblings attempt to find the person both they and Rahl want dead, the Seeker's hunt for the Stone of Tears leads him to befriend a stranger who claims he's uncovered secrets crucial to Richard's quest. But the real mystery surrounding this man sends Richard and Zedd on a collision course with the past - and each other.

episodes.name: Walter
episodes.summary: When a Sister of the Dark steals an ancient scroll containing secrets critical to their quest for the Stone of Tears, Richard, Kahlan, Zedd and Cara set out to recover the all-important document and thwart the Keeper's deadly scheme to destroy all life. Meanwhile, Darken Rahl grows weary of his tenure in the Underworld and hatches a lethal plot to return to the land of the living using a hapless lookalike named Walter - a plan which could require the unwilling assistance of the Seeker.

episodes.name: Extinction
episodes.summary: Newly resurrected Darken Rahl plans to stay alive by using the secrets of an ancient scroll to defy the Keeper, forcing Richard into an uneasy alliance with Rahl to find the Stone of Tears and defeat the Keeper once and for all. Elsewhere, Kahlan and Cara fight to save the last of a species all but wiped out by Rahl's scheme, while the Keeper dispatches the deadly Sisters of the Dark to return Rahl to the Underworld.

episodes.name: Eternity
episodes.summary: Led by a magical compass to the location of the Stone of Tears, Richard and Kahlan enter a mysterious, hidden valley. They find it occupied by a people whose sole purpose is to guard the object of the Seeker's arduous search, and discover it's a land from which they cannot leave. Meanwhile, outside the valley Cara's reunion with a woman from her past leads her and Zedd into a deadly trap.

episodes.name: Unbroken
episodes.summary: The Seeker is in a race against time to regain control of the Stone of Tears from Darken Rahl and prevent the Keeper's imminent victory over the world of living. After an intense battle, Richard captures Cara, whom Darken Rahl turned against him, and Zedd attempts to reverse the insidious dark magic that caused the Mord'Sith to betray her friends. But the wizard's powerful spell instead drastically alters the lives of Richard, Kahlan and everyone else.

episodes.name: Tears
episodes.summary: Worlds collide and trusts are betrayed in the powerful second season finale. Richard, separated from his companions, continues his quest to defeat the Keeper once and for all. With the Stone of Tears in hand, he reaches the Pillars of Creation in an attempt to seal the many rifts opening to the Underworld, but soon comes face-to-face with his greatest enemy. Meanwhile, Kahlan falls under the control of the omnipotent Sister Nicci, who sends the Mother Confessor on a mission of destruction.

show.name: Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman
show.summary: A sleek, sexy, Emmy-nominated 1990s take on the enduring superhero, culled from DC Comics, which has spawned numerous successful film and TV versions of him as boy and man. All of which further demonstrated that while Kryptonite can kill the Man of Steel, changing times can't. Here, leads Dean Cain and Teri Hatcher have the looks and the chemistry, and the timeless question (seriously, how can Lois NOT know Clark is Superman?) plays itself out until they find true love.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: Clark's parents devise a superhero persona so he can investigate Luthor's connection to the sabotage of a space shuttle.

episodes.name: Strange Visitor (from Another Planet)
episodes.summary: A renegade government agent targets Clark and Lois in an attempt to capture Superman.

episodes.name: Neverending Battle
episodes.summary: Luthor engages Superman in tests that make him confront the limitations of his powers.

episodes.name: I'm Looking Through You
episodes.summary: An invisible man terrorizes Metropolis, staging violent robberies and helping vicious criminals escape.

episodes.name: Requiem for a Superhero
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark investigate some strangely powerful boxers - and Lois is surprised to discover the man behind their secret is her estranged father.

episodes.name: I've Got a Crush on You
episodes.summary: Lois' undercover persona, a nightclub singer, arouses unexpected interest. Plus, can Superman halt the activities of a group of arsonists?

episodes.name: Smart Kids
episodes.summary: Juvenile delinquents playing high-tech pranks are hooked on a dangerous drug that boosts intelligence.

episodes.name: The Green, Green Glow of Home
episodes.summary: A friend of Jonathan and Martha has found a strange meteorite, Jason Trask is back and now he is in Smallville, looking for this meteorite that can destroy Superman, and Lois and Clark go to Smallville to investigate the story and Clark introduces her to his parents.

episodes.name: The Man of Steel Bars
episodes.summary: Superman winds up in jail after authorities decide he is responsible for a freak winter heat wave.

episodes.name: Pheromone, My Lovely
episodes.summary: A powerful perfume leads Lois to unleash her hidden feelings for Clark, who isn't too pleased with the situation.

episodes.name: Honeymoon in Metropolis
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark cannot ignore their growing attraction to each other while posing as newlyweds during a surveillance operation.

episodes.name: All Shook Up
episodes.summary: Superman's encounter with an asteroid headed for Earth results in amnesia for Clark, who forgets how to use his powers.

episodes.name: Witness
episodes.summary: Lois' life is in danger when she witnesses the murder of a scientist who was claiming to know the secret to increased male potency. Now, Clark and Perry need to protect her from the murderer, Mr Make-up, and from the scientist's affair from the past.

episodes.name: Illusions of Grandeur
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark work to uncover the truth behind some strange disappearances that lead to mystery, magic, and a possible murder.

episodes.name: The Ides of Metropolis
episodes.summary: Clark is skeptical as a sympathetic Lois harbors a fugitive and they search for an antidote to a world-threatening computer virus.

episodes.name: Foundling
episodes.summary: As Clark begins to discover more about his mysterious past, Lex Luthor also learns more about Superman's true identity.

episodes.name: The Rival
episodes.summary: Lois is overcome by jealousy when her college rival publishes several top news stories and also expresses a romantic interest in Clark.

episodes.name: Vatman
episodes.summary: Clark senses a kindred spirit when he is confronted by a new enemy: a Superman clone determined to destroy the man of steel.

episodes.name: Fly Hard
episodes.summary: Clark's true identity is in jeopardy when he is forced to save friends who are taken hostage when terrorists invade the Daily Planet.

episodes.name: Barbarians at the Planet
episodes.summary: Clark may lose his position and his partner when Lex Luthor takes over both the Daily Planet newspaper and Lois' affections.

episodes.name: The House of Luthor
episodes.summary: Lois agrees to marry Luthor, unaware he has imprisoned Superman in a cell made of kryptonite.

episodes.name: Madame Ex
episodes.summary: Luthor's ex-wife hires a Lois look-alike to discredit Lois and destroy Superman.

episodes.name: Wall of Sound
episodes.summary: An award nomination creates a rift between Clark and Lois; strange sounds cripple the city and Superman.

episodes.name: The Source
episodes.summary: While trying to get Lois reinstated in her job, Lois and Clark uncover political and corporate corruption.

episodes.name: The Prankster
episodes.summary: When Lois receives mysterious gifts, she and Clark link them to the creation of a nuclear weapon.

episodes.name: Church of Metropolis
episodes.summary: An international crime group targets Lois and her uncle; a prosecutor lusts for Clark but despises Superman.

episodes.name: Operation Blackout
episodes.summary: A blackout is linked to a computer genius and a colonel set to hijack a satellite that can destroy the world.

episodes.name: That Old Gang of Mine
episodes.summary: Clark is mortally injured when a genetic experiment regenerates three infamous mobsters and a lethal gun moll.

episodes.name: A Bolt from the Blue
episodes.summary: A misfit gains powers equal to Superman's; a deranged scientist wants to transform them to a Superman foe.

episodes.name: Season's Greedings
episodes.summary: A bitter inventor's new toy brings out the worst in the shoppers of Metropolis during the holiday season.

episodes.name: Metallo
episodes.summary: Superman must fight a cyborg powered by kryptonite.

episodes.name: Chi of Steel
episodes.summary: Superman copes with Far East mysticism when Chinatown robberies are linked to a Ninja master.

episodes.name: The Eyes Have It
episodes.summary: After acquiring a device that carries information on a beam of light, Lois is kidnapped by an evil ophthalmologist.

episodes.name: The Phoenix
episodes.summary: Lex Luthor returns from the grave to win back Lois and exact revenge on Superman.

episodes.name: Top Copy
episodes.summary: An assassin posing as a TV journalist attempts to reveal Superman's identity and kill him.

episodes.name: Return of the Prankster
episodes.summary: The Prankster jeopardizes Lois' interview with the president.

episodes.name: Lucky Leon
episodes.summary: Superman unwittingly aids the hijacking of a shipment of nuclear warheads; Clark and Lois ready for their first date.

episodes.name: Resurrection
episodes.summary: A deranged scientist plots to release a deadly virus in Metropolis; Lois' attraction to a government agent irks Clark.

episodes.name: Tempus Fugitive
episodes.summary: H.G. Wells' time machine carries Lois and Clark to 1966 Smallville to prevent a futuristic villain from killing the infant Superman.

episodes.name: Target: Jimmy Olsen!
episodes.summary: Jimmy falls under the influence of a mind-controlling serum that turns its victims into assassins who kill on command.

episodes.name: Individual Responsibility
episodes.summary: After exposure to red kryptonite, a depressed Superman doesn't respond when Intergang kidnaps Perry.

episodes.name: Whine, Whine, Whine
episodes.summary: Lois must choose Clark, Superman or Dan Scardino; a lawsuit threatens Superman's future.

episodes.name: And the Answer Is...
episodes.summary: A blackmailer threatens to reveal Clark's secret; Clark proposes to Lois.

episodes.name: ... We Have a Lot to Talk About
episodes.summary: Lois ponders Clark's marriage proposal; Superman continues his quest to rid Metropolis of Intergang.

episodes.name: Ordinary People
episodes.summary: A criminal kingpin with a freakish physique uses a seemingly harmless entertainment empire to acquire Superman's body.

episodes.name: Contact
episodes.summary: Using hypnosis, a vengeful computer whiz gains control of Lois; later, he uses her to distract Superman while he destroys the global software market.

episodes.name: When Irish Eyes Are Killing
episodes.summary: A man from Lois' past arrives in Metropolis to claim an ancient Irish artifact with mystical powers.

episodes.name: Just Say Noah
episodes.summary: Posing as lovebirds, Clark and Lois discover a fanatical marriage therapist is recruiting his patients to form a new society.

episodes.name: Don't Tug on Superman's Cape
episodes.summary: A wealthy couple with a passion for rare objects seek the help of an escaped criminal to add Superman to their collection.

episodes.name: Ultra Woman
episodes.summary: Devious sisters plan to make Superman mortal but mistakenly transfer his powers to Lois who becomes Ultra Woman.

episodes.name: Chip Off the Old Clark
episodes.summary: Clark and Lois investigate a Metropolis woman's claim that she bore Superman's love child.

episodes.name: Super Mann
episodes.summary: Three Nazi soldiers awaken from a scientific hibernation and devise a scheme to lead a group of followers to a new Third Reich.

episodes.name: Virtually Destroyed
episodes.summary: Superman must rely on Jimmy's computer savvy to rescue Lois from a madman's virtual world.

episodes.name: Home Is Where the Hurt Is
episodes.summary: Mindy Church, the new leader of Intergang, exposes Superman to a rare virus from the planet Krypton which renders the superhero powerless and Lois' estranged parents visit for the holidays.

episodes.name: Never on Sunday
episodes.summary: Clark is placed at the mercy of a renowned illusionist's voodoo powers when the man arrives in Metropolis seeking vengeance. Meanwhile, Lois's mother hires a consultant to help with the wedding, but plans quickly spin out of control.

episodes.name: The Dad Who Came in from the Cold
episodes.summary: Jimmy's father, secret agent Jack Olsen, is assigned to retrieve a computer disk he believes is in the possession of Lois and Clark, and he is prepared to stop at nothing to get it back.

episodes.name: Tempus Anyone?
episodes.summary: Time-traveler Tempus kidnaps Lois and takes her to a parallel universe where she must persuade the alternate Clark to become Superman.

episodes.name: I Now Pronounce You...
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark's impending wedding is threatened by many obstacles, including a tardy minister and a biologist intent on killing the president.

episodes.name: Double Jeopardy
episodes.summary: Lex Luthor returns to Metropolis with a plot to recapture Lois' heart; a stranger comes to her aid.

episodes.name: Seconds
episodes.summary: Lex Luthor holds Lois prisoner in his underground lair and takes the final steps to separate her and Superman forever.

episodes.name: Forget Me Not
episodes.summary: Lois tries to regain her memory in a psychiatric hospital, while under the care of a doctor who is brainwashing his patients to be hit men.

episodes.name: Oedipus Wrecks
episodes.summary: Lois returns to work and teams up with Clark to stop a villain from using a memory-loss weapon on the residents of Metropolis.

episodes.name: It's a Small World After All
episodes.summary: Lois searches for an antidote to a shrinking potion after her former classmate shrinks and kidnaps her classmates' loved ones, including Clark.

episodes.name: Through a Glass, Darkly
episodes.summary: Two mysterious strangers jeopardize Metropolis residents when they test Superman's loyalty and powers.

episodes.name: Big Girls Don't Fly
episodes.summary: Two strangers offer Superman an opportunity; a hideous assassin targets the man of steel.

episodes.name: Lord of the Flys
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark's relationship hangs in the balance as Clark is forced to adhere to Kryptonian law and marry the woman he was pledged to at birth.

episodes.name: Battleground Earth
episodes.summary: Clark faces charges of treason for betraying the people of New Krypton after returning to Earth to stop Lord Nor's hostile takeover.

episodes.name: Swear to God, This Time We're Not Kidding
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark must act quickly to prevent an old nemesis from destroying their impending wedding.

episodes.name: Soul Mates
episodes.summary: The newlyweds travel back in time with H.G. Wells to remove a curse cast on the couple's love centuries ago.

episodes.name: Brutal Youth
episodes.summary: A crazed scientist performs an aging experiment on Jimmy.

episodes.name: The People vs. Lois Lane
episodes.summary: A murder frame-up sends Lois to jail.

episodes.name: Dead Lois Walking
episodes.summary: Lois escapes from prison and goes on the lam.

episodes.name: Bob and Carol and Lois and Clark
episodes.summary: Duos' new pal hides his identity.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.summary: A con artist tells the newlyweds their home is haunted.

episodes.name: Stop the Presses
episodes.summary: Lois becomes editor in chief when Perry gets a corporate promotion; spoiled, wealthy young brothers conspire to assassinate Superman.

episodes.name: 'Twas the Night Before Mxymas
episodes.summary: An elf casts a spell looping time.

episodes.name: Lethal Weapon
episodes.summary: Superman loses his powers.

episodes.name: Sex, Lies and Videotape
episodes.summary: A corrupt, fame-seeking tycoon tries to discredit Superman by releasing a photograph of the Man of Steel and Lois in an embrace.

episodes.name: Meet John Doe
episodes.summary: An evil time-traveler brainwashes the country.

episodes.name: Lois and Clarks
episodes.summary: H.G. Wells brings an alternate Superman to help Lois rescue her husband from Tempus' clutches.

episodes.name: AKA Superman
episodes.summary: A Superman fan seduces Jimmy.

episodes.name: Faster Than a Speeding Vixen
episodes.summary: Superman meets a female superhero.

episodes.name: Shadow of a Doubt
episodes.summary: Lex Luthor's scheming son, the newspaper's new owner, makes a play for Lois.

episodes.name: Voice from the Past
episodes.summary: Clark must rescue kidnapped Lois from lovesick Leslie.

episodes.name: I've Got You Under My Skin
episodes.summary: A fugitive from the mob switches bodies with Clark causing him to search for a way to reverse the process.

episodes.name: Toy Story
episodes.summary: A childlike man conspires to kidnap the city's children.

episodes.name: The Family Hour
episodes.summary: Couple gets news about family addition.
